page.layout: One page of verse, one column, set in stanzas. Running head at the top, with page number 7 at the top right. No margin notes. Handwritten mark "A 4" at the lower right, not printed, left out.

main_text.p: Claro renidens vertice Superbus hostis ambulat, Primasque sedes obtinet Rebus quietus prosperis.
Quòd summus orbis arbiter Nefanda gentis crimina Isacidarum vindicat Iustisq; poenis eluit.
Victoris ante Barbari Vultus retortos ocyus [?] Infantium tenellula Migrare turba cogitur.
Syonis omne fulgidum Decus repente concidit: Gentisque priscæ gloriam Funestus hostis perdidit.
Longis Duces ieiuniis Syone tota languidi, Ceu destituta pabulo Virente cerua, corruunt.
Fractisque fessos viribus Securus hostis insequens Adurget, atque patriis Abire cogit finibus.

page.notes: The handwritten mark "A 4" at the lower right is not printed and is left out. The word "ocyus" is printed "otyus" in the scan, so the reading is doubtful and marked [?]. Show-through from the other side of the leaf is ignored. The "Victoris" and "Barbari" lines are printed with ligatures that are read with some uncertainty.
